notes: CLM-2024-20011. DOL 18/06/2024 (first event). HO-3 with HO-0304 ed. 03-24 and HO-0820 ed. 05-24 attached. Thunderstorm on 18 June, basement floor drain backed up; a second storm on 22 June backed it up again after cleanup had started. Two separate contractor invoices, 7,400 and 6,100. Deductible on the dec page is 1,000. Insured wants to know if we pay both in full.

CLM-2024-20012. Date of loss 9 July 2024. HO-3, HO-0304 ed. 03-24 attached. Cloudburst, water pooled on the rear lawn and ran in under the patio door into the family room. Insured says it is a water damage claim like the neighbour's burst pipe and asks if E-17 covers it. Excess 1,000.

CLM-2024-20013. DOL 2024-04-02. HO-3 with HO-0304 ed. 03-24. Braided supply hose under the kitchen sink split overnight, found at 6am, insured shut off the main straight away. Plumber replaced the hose that morning and the insured put the old hose out with the rubbish before our field visit on 4 April. Excess 500.

CLM-2024-20014. DOL 11 Jun 2024. HO-3 with HO-0415 ed. 01-24. Hail on 11 June bruised the asphalt shingles. Insured called on 2 July because water is now coming through the bedroom ceiling below the damaged slope. Roofer's report says several impacts went through to the underlayment. Excess 2,500.

CLM-2024-20021. DOL 2024-08-03. HO-3 with HO-0820 ed. 05-24. Sump pump motor burned out during a storm on 3 August, about 10 cm of water in the finished basement. No power outage. Electrician's note says the motor seized and the pump had been running normally until then. Insured replaced the battery backup in March 2023 but has no record of testing the pump every 90 days. Excess 1,000.

CLM-2024-20022. DOL 20 May 2024. HO-3 with HO-0415 ed. 01-24. Windstorm tore two metal panels off the roof on 20 May, reported the next day. Insured put tarps over the gap and waited. Our inspection was not done until 29 July because of the backlog. Water came in before the tarps went on. Excess 2,500.

CLM-2025-20023. DOL 14/01/2025. DP-3 rental dwelling, DP-0703 ed. 02-24. Previous tenancy ended 2 December 2024; landlord walked through the property on 5 December but did not write anything down about the plumbing. New tenant moved in 10 December and was in occupation when a supply pipe burst on 14 January. Heating log shows 64F throughout.

CLM-2024-20024. DOL 2024-10-12. HO-3 with HO-0509 ed. 06-24. Insured started a bookkeeping business at home in July 2024, grossing about 30,000 so far, and never notified us. Kitchen grease fire on 12 October spread into the home office. Claim includes a business laptop and printer worth 3,200 along with kitchen and household contents. Excess 1,000.

CLM-2024-20031. DOL 2024-02-19. HO-3 homeowners, owner occupied, HO-0304 ed. 03-24 attached. Insured was away for 40 days; a neighbour noticed water under the front door on 19 February. Plumber puts the burst on the upstairs toilet supply line at about 3 days before discovery. Water was not shut off while they were away. Excess 1,000.

CLM-2025-20032. DOL 2025-01-08. Dwelling fire DP-3 on a tenant-occupied rental; DP-0703 ed. 02-24 is the only endorsement on the policy. Municipal sewer backed up through the floor drain into the basement unit, about 8,000 of damage. Landlord asks us to confirm the 10,000 water backup limit applies. Excess 500.

CLM-2025-20033. DOL 21 January 2025. HO-3 homeowners, owner occupied, HO-0304 ed. 03-24 attached. During a cold snap the insured kept the thermostat at 50F; a pipe froze and split in the crawlspace and was found the same afternoon. Excess 1,000.

CLM-2024-20034. DOL 2024-09-03. Dec page shows HO-3 with HO-0415 ed. 05-23. Hail dented the metal roof panels on 3 September, no leaks, roof still sheds water. Please confirm our E-22 position. Excess 2,500.

CLM-2024-20035. DOL 2024-11-30. Insured's HO-3 covers their own home, HO-0304 ed. 03-24 attached. The loss is at a condo the insured owns in another city and rents out; it stood empty 45 days between tenants and the water was left on when a supply line burst. Excess 1,000.

CLM-2024-20041. DOL 2024-03-28 (date discovered). HO-3 with HO-0304 ed. 03-24. Insured came back from an 18-day trip to find the dishwasher supply line had split. Plumber's moisture mapping and the water bill both put the start of the leak at about the day they left. Excess 1,000.

CLM-2024-20042. DOL 2024-09-16. HO-3 with HO-0509 ed. 06-24; insured notified us of the home day care in July 2024. Insured minds 3 children and charges each family 150 dollars a week. A child fell on the stairs and the parents are claiming medical costs.

CLM-2024-20043. DOL 2024-12-02. HO-3 with HO-0509 ed. 06-24. Insured sells handmade jewellery from home; gross receipts over the last 12 months were 4,200. A customer collecting an order slipped on the icy front step and is claiming for a broken wrist.

CLM-2024-20044. DOL 7 July 2024. HO-3 with HO-0415 ed. 01-24. Hail dented the standing-seam metal roof on 7 July and split two panels along the seams; the attic took water the same night. Excess 2,500.
CLM-2024-20051. DOL 2024-05-05. HO-0304 ed. 03-24. Washing machine hose let go while the family were out at dinner, kitchen ceiling came down. Excess 1,000.
CLM-2024-20052. DOL 14 August 2024. HO-0509 ed. 06-24. Two work laptops, 2,800 total, taken to a client's office and stolen from the meeting room. Excess 250.
CLM-2024-20053. DOL 2024-06-30. HO-0612 ed. 03-24, Coverage A 350,000. After the fire the contractor recommends rewiring beyond what the code requires while the walls are open. Insured wants it paid.
CLM-2024-20054. DOL 2024-04-11. HO-0612 ed. 03-24. Council will not sign off the rebuild until an asbestos survey and air monitoring are done, quote 3,500. Excess 1,000.

CLM-2024-20055. DOL 2024-10-02. HO-0304 ed. 03-24. Leak behind the shower wall ran about 10 days before it was found and mould has spread through the wall cavity. Insured wants mould remediation paid.
